scope: Verified each listed requirement against the supplied ISO 32000-2:2020 sponsored EC3 7.4.7/Table 12 and the locally supplied ITU-T T.88 (02/2000) base text: segment grammar/types, generic/refinement, arithmetic coding/integers, symbols/text, retention, Huffman Tables B.1–B.15 and user tables, patterns, halftones, gray planes, page flags/operators and stripes. MMR modes and run words were cross-checked against local T.6 (11/1988) and T.4 (07/2003). This is clause-level implementation review with generated and known-answer tests, not complete PDF or T.88 conformance certification. The extended generic-template and header clauses were additionally reviewed against T.88 (08/2018), identical ISO/IEC 14492:2019, which PDF 7.4.7 references. Other revised clauses are not claimed reviewed. PDF excludes the colour extension. The contradictory AT field length is recorded in jbig2-extended-template. Profile metadata is parsed but profile feature-set compliance is not separately validated. Two explicit compatibility cases are marked strict_valid=false: PDF-global retention across separate streams and standalone arithmetic text stopping at its declared instance count. Their acceptance is not evidence that those encodings conform to T.88. The unknown-length framing, all eight text layouts, stripe padding and profile metadata grammar were rechecked against base-text 7.2.7, 7.4.6.3–7.4.6.4, 6.4.5, 7.4.10 and 7.4.12. Annex F Tables F.1–F.7 were read: their additional restrictions remain an implementation gap, not a pending primary-text review.

requirements.description: Extended generic template 0 moves twelve of the existing sixteen context positions. Context identity and typical prediction do not change when a pixel moves; out-of-bitmap pixels are zero.
requirements.gaps: Hosted acceptance pending. T.88:2018 7.4.6.3 calls the field 32 bytes, but Figure 50 and the explicit byte 0..23 list define twelve signed X/Y pairs. The decoder follows that explicit 24-byte layout. It does not skip eight unspecified bytes or guess a second layout. The official ITU catalogue listed no later correction when reviewed; this is a documented resolution of contradictory primary text, not an unqualified conformance claim.

primary_text_review.rule: Twelve signed coordinate pairs select causal adaptive pixels. EXTTEMPLATE is used only for arithmetic template 0. It is unused for templates 1-3; TPGDON and EXTTEMPLATE are unused in MMR, whose GBTEMPLATE must nevertheless be zero. Bits 5-7 remain reserved. Unknown-length framing begins its marker search after the entire AT header and consumes the actual-row count.
primary_text_review.implementation_agreement: One flags/header owner supplies both decode and unknown-length framing. Existing arithmetic contexts, bitmap and windowed decoder are retained; no new decoder or heuristic field fallback.
primary_text_review.generated_expectations_agreement: Original geometric bitmaps precede arithmetic encoding. Controls move each AT separately, all twelve together, overlap and extreme causal coordinates, typical rows, every truncated AT length, each noncausal pair, and marker-looking late-header bytes followed by a segment.
primary_text_review.verdict: The explicit field list and figures support the implemented layout, subject to the recorded primary-text contradiction.

requirements.resource_contract: An unknown-length 5x3 extended region on a 5x5 page, followed by a 5x1 region, holds 5+3+65536*sizeof(Context) bytes and charges (25+15+5)*18 raster work units plus 3 segment operations. The encoded 0xFFFFFFFF height does not determine allocation. Existing template 2 bounds remain unchanged; each one-short limit is exercised.

documented_choices: No engine source or code tables were copied. Huffman numeric parameters and published codewords come from Annex B; arithmetic and fax parameters were checked against their local primary tables.
The H.2 published numeric arithmetic test independently constrains both the Python encoder and Rust decoder; it is additional evidence alongside geometric bitmaps.
Bitmap storage is retained until decode completion; logical availability nevertheless follows retention flags, including deferred attached extensions.

The base text does not explicitly settle zero-sized page/region/symbol/refinement dimensions. This decoder requires nonzero dimensions for those bitmaps; pattern dimensions are explicitly nonzero in 7.4.4.1.2–7.4.4.1.3. Empty text instance lists and one-pattern halftones are supported.
Byte-alignment bits that the text directs the decoder to skip are not interpreted, including MMR trailing alignment bits. Raw collective symbol row padding is checked for zero.
The first stripe uses the literal end-row distance from row zero in 7.4.8.6; a zero maximum permits a first end row of zero. Later stripes must advance and respect the declared maximum.
Profile segments are bounded metadata with ordering and global/page list constraints; the decoder does not validate every Annex F feature-set restriction.
Unknown non-necessary extension payloads are skipped as permitted by 7.4.14; unknown necessary extensions never produce partial successful pages.

High-level aggregation parameter conventions were studied in hayro in the preceding implementation; this review derives them directly from T.88 Tables 17–18. No external implementation fragments were copied.

Retention is enforced within each input stream. At the PDF globals/page boundary all decoded global resources remain available to preserve the established image-adapter contract. This does not establish that a zero-retain global encoding meets T.88 7.2.4; its explicit compatibility vector has strict_valid=false.

Standalone arithmetic text returns after its declared instance count. A final strip OOB is generated for all conforming vectors and consumed for aggregates, but is not validated in standalone arithmetic text. The compatibility vector omitting it has strict_valid=false.

Public fixture helper defaults preserve existing consumers in the image area. New JBIG2 vectors use explicit retained headers and complete strips; no image fixtures or manifests outside this area were changed.
Huffman segment setup conservatively charges all 184 standard-table rows before constructing any tables, including aggregation tables, so empty segments cannot bypass the operation budget.

Page-reference refinement uses a borrowed clipped view under 7.4.7.4; adjacent page samples are outside the reference bitmap and therefore zero under 6.3.5.2. This base-edition interpretation disagrees with the recorded competitor results. No claim is made about later amendments.

MMR caches each reference transition pair; b1 and b2 scans advance across each reference row at most linearly. A sparse-reference/dense-row vector exercises repeated horizontal codes before a long reference run.

Stripe checks ignore identity source operands (OR/XOR zero and AND/XNOR one), after page clipping. All other operands count as drawing even when the destination already has the same value; REPLACE always counts as drawing. This certifies untouched stripe pixels without depending on retained output values.

Unknown-length arithmetic framing parses the adaptive-template header before scanning coded data. A legal FF AC adaptive coordinate pair is header data, not the arithmetic terminator (7.4.6.3 and 7.2.7). Only actual row counts are allocated, even when the declared region height is 0xFFFFFFFF.
